pages.text: Spawns an entity, such as a pig, at a position.$(br2)The result is the UUID of the new entity. This needs allowSpawning or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised. An unknown type raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the entity appears$(li)$(1)type$() STRING: the entity type, e.g. minecraft:pig$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the UUID of the entity
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SPAWN_ENTITY$(br)  PARAMETER position pen ;$(br)  PARAMETER type "minecraft:pig" ;$(br)  RESULT result pigId$()
